nodes.name: You (browser, ssh)
nodes.what: Reach the bridge UI and the console through ssh ai (Tailscale); nothing on ai listens beyond loopback except the tailnet peer port.

nodes.name: ai (core)
nodes.where: Wyse, Debian 13, on the tailnet and the LAN
nodes.what: The trusted core: runs the agent harness, the desk, the broker, the firewall that gates the sandbox, and memory.

nodes.name: sbx (sandbox box)
nodes.where: Wyse, Debian 13, 10.77.0.2 on the private cable
nodes.what: Runs tool code in bwrap. Knows only the core's address; reached only by the broker's forced-command key.

nodes.name: win11 (browserbox)
nodes.what: Chrome driven by browserbox's gate.py, for the page and fetch tools. Off since the move to ai.

nodes.name: Model API (DeepSeek)
nodes.what: The LLM. Pi calls it from the core; the core's own egress is open by design.

nodes.name: Bitwarden Secrets
nodes.what: Holds the model keys (and SBX_GATE when page/fetch are on). Fetched by root before pi-bridge starts.

nodes.name: Bridge web UI
nodes.what: Module engine: sessions, chat, dirs, tree, inspector. Text only reaches the DOM as text nodes.

nodes.name: pi-bridge
nodes.what: HTTP/SSE API over Pi's RPC mode. Every session and every input first goes through the session gate.

nodes.name: sbx-fetch-secrets
nodes.what: Reads the Bitwarden token (root 0600) and writes /run/pi-bridge-secrets/secrets.env (root:pibridge 0640).

nodes.name: Pi 1.2.0 (Node)
nodes.what: The coding agent, locked down: --offline, no builtin tools, no extensions but the desk extension.

nodes.name: sbx-session-gate
nodes.what: Holds the tighten-only token and forces the session firewall profile. Callers: the bridge and the broker.

nodes.name: sbx-console
nodes.what: Firewall profiles (session/build), tools on/off, settings. Renders and applies the nftables ruleset.

nodes.name: nftables: table inet sbxfw
nodes.what: Default-deny input and forward. Sandbox traffic is masqueraded and allowlisted; forwarding turns on only after this table loads.

nodes.name: agent-desk (deskbox)
nodes.what: Contract-enforced tool calls: validates input against tcs.yaml, runs each stub in bwrap with seccomp and no network, signs the job.

nodes.name: tool stub (<tool>-sbx)
nodes.what: Generated by sync.py from harness/stub/run.py. Its only door is the broker socket bound into the job.

nodes.name: sbx-broker
nodes.what: Checks the desk's job signature, holds the serial lane, locks the firewall before net jobs, and runs the job on sbx over SSH.

nodes.name: Loom
nodes.what: Local memory. pi-bridge posts settled turns only with --loom-url (off), after the output redactor.

nodes.name: Ollama
nodes.what: Embeddings for Loom (nomic-embed-text, digest pinned).

nodes.name: sshd → sbx-channel
nodes.what: The only way in: the broker's key, forced through sbx-channel (run, reset, install).

nodes.name: sbx-run
nodes.what: Runs one tool in bwrap: no network unless tools.list says net, the workspace only for work tools, limits and a timeout.

nodes.name: tools (bwrap)
nodes.what: greet, netcheck, page, fetch, bash, read, write, edit, glob, grep.

nodes.name: browserbox gate
nodes.where: Windows PC on the LAN, port 9011 (bearer token)
nodes.what: Fetches and renders pages for page/fetch. The one deliberate hole in sbx's firewall, currently closed.

flows: job in bwrap, no network, signed
ssh forced command over the cable
